behaviour: Opening a channel shows its latest messages in order; switching channels shows each one's own
Scrolling back through a long history shows every message once, in order
Scroll to bottom is offered when scrolled up and returns to the latest message
A new message arrives in view at the end, and does not move a reader who is scrolled up
A link to a message, a reply or a missing message opens the right place; Copy link gives such a link
Reading forward from an old message reaches the latest with nothing missing or repeated
A message sent with Enter or the button shows once, in order, for both people, live and after reload
Messages two people send at the same moment end in one order for both
Line breaks, formatting, links, emoji, other scripts, pasted and long text arrive as written; authors are grouped
Editing my message shows the new text and (edited) to everyone; cancel leaves it
Deleting my message removes it for everyone; one with replies leaves a placeholder
Only a message's author is offered Edit and Delete
Reactions show, count and go for both people, on messages and replies
Another person's edit, reaction and deletion show without reload
Copy Text copies a message's text
Replies show under their message in order for both people, live and after reload; long threads fold and open
Editing, deleting and reacting to a reply show to the other person without reload
Reply puts the keyboard in the reply box
After a lost connection or a hidden page, missed messages appear; a message written offline is neither lost nor doubled
Losing the connection in the first seconds after the app opened does not ask for a reload
What a person does in one window shows in their other window
A draft stays with its channel, survives reload, and is cleared by sending
The send button is off when empty; the composer is ready again after sending and takes the cursor when a channel is chosen
A person or @here picked from the @ menu is sent as a mention, for both people
Files and pictures attach, show before sending, arrive for both people and list under Attachments
The other person's typing shows as … is typing, and goes when they send or stop
Unread marks, the New divider, the unread chip and Mark as read follow what I have and have not seen
A mention of me shows a count of mentions on the channel's row
A muted channel shows a crossed bell and is not marked unread; unmuting undoes it
A channel I am added to shows in my list at once, or when I next open the app
The first message in a new channel marks it unread for the other member
A direct message or named group I start reaches the others, continues one conversation, and can be answered
A teammate is offered by name in New direct message
A private or team channel made in the app opens, lists and takes messages; its history starts with a created line
Renaming a channel updates header and list for every member and is announced
A channel can be made a favorite and taken out again
Copy Link on a channel gives an address that opens it for another member
Deleting a channel removes it for owner and members at once; only the owner is offered it
Participants lists members with the owner marked; switching tabs keeps the message list where it was
Inviting and removing people takes effect at once for everyone, with lines between the right messages
People without access see nothing of a channel; asking to join, approving, denying and withdrawing work; team channels can be found and joined by teammates only
Find in channel counts matches, steps through them, reaches old messages and closes
Arrow keys, Escape and message hotkeys move between composer, messages and list
Starting, joining and leaving calls from a channel, the Calls tab
reason: Needs real media devices and the call service's media server, which a local stack does not run; calls have their own backend-free browser suite
